text: An earthquake in Alaska made water slosh on the coast of Texas.
March 1964. The largest earthquake in United States history.
And not just Texas. Waterways sloshed as far as the coast of Louisiana.
Water-level recorders in forty-seven states registered it.
In Seattle, more than twelve hundred miles away, the Space Needle swayed.
And the US Geological Survey says it made the entire Earth ring like a bell.
So how big does an earthquake have to be to make a whole planet ring? The number's in the full video, linked right here.
